# Emitted CUDA twins (`cuda/emitted/`)

**Do not hand-edit.** Sources here are generated by `parcae-compile` from theory
DSL IR (see [`docs/architecture/python-transpiler.md`](../../../../docs/architecture/python-transpiler.md)).

This directory holds **stream transform twins** (`DslEmitCuda` → 1D apply
kernels). It is **not** the fused-χ² **hist** product used for theory search
Kernel SLO. Hist plans/sources/modules belong under the theory artifact
`hist/` tree (`data/theories/<name>/<ver>/hist/`) — see
[`theory-artifact.md`](../../../../docs/spec/theory-artifact.md) and
[`theory-hist-transpile.md`](../../../../docs/architecture/theory-hist-transpile.md).

Hand-written catalog twins remain in the parent [`../`](../) directory
(`CaesarKernel`, `FamilyChi2Batch`, `theory_hist_chi2_s1/s2`, …).

## Style (HARD)

Generated public APIs **MUST** use top-level classes and header guards — **no**
C++ namespaces:

```cpp
#ifndef NAME_HPP
#define NAME_HPP
class Name {
public:
  // …
private:
  Name() = delete;
};
#endif // NAME_HPP
```

New theory-hist / search CUDA **MUST** use file-scope `__global__` + class
façades (no anonymous `namespace` in new or rewritten units) — see
[`theory-hist-transpile.md`](../../../../docs/architecture/theory-hist-transpile.md).
Arithmetic must call `Z29Device`.

## Git policy

Generated `.hpp` / `.cu` under this folder are **gitignored**. This README is
kept so the directory exists in a fresh clone / VS tree.

Artifact manifests under `data/theories/<name>/<version>/` record relative
`paths.cuda_header` / `paths.cuda_source` into this tree when stream CUDA
sources are emitted. Fused-hist paths use `paths.hist_*` under `hist/`, not here.
